title: Resume Generator Application Config Schema
description: JSON schema for the application configuration

output_dir.description: Directory where generated resumes will be saved. Defaults to `RESUME_DATA_DIR/output` if not specified.

output_filename.description: Template for naming generated resume files. Use placeholders like {author} and {date}.

overwrite_existing.description: Whether to overwrite existing files in the output directory

template_dir.description: Directory where resume templates are stored. Defaults to the internal templates directory if not specified.

template_name.description: Filename of the resume template to use
